description: This file contains testing utilities and classes for Flask applications, including custom test client, environment builder, and CLI runner for testing Flask apps.

classes.name: EnvironBuilder
classes.description: A subclass of werkzeug.test.EnvironBuilder that initializes defaults from a Flask application and provides JSON serialization.

classes.name: FlaskClient
classes.description: A custom test client for Flask applications, extending werkzeug.test.Client, with session transaction support and context preservation.

classes.name: FlaskCliRunner
classes.description: A CLI runner for testing Flask CLI commands, extending click.testing.CliRunner.

methods.name: json_dumps
methods.description: Serializes an object to a JSON-formatted string using the Flask app's JSON serializer.

methods.name: _get_werkzeug_version
methods.description: Retrieves the current version of the Werkzeug package.

methods.name: session_transaction
methods.description: Provides a context manager to modify the session during testing.

methods.name: _copy_environ
methods.description: Creates a copy of the environment dictionary, optionally preserving context.

methods.name: _request_from_builder_args
methods.description: Constructs a BaseRequest object from builder arguments.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Performs a test request, handling various input types and managing context stack.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Enables use of the FlaskClient as a context manager.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Cleans up context stack when exiting the FlaskClient context.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Invokes a CLI command in an isolated environment for testing Flask CLI commands.
